did: Remade the open-question essay on why our merges wait in line on a free GitHub account, as merge-queue-2026-11-24. The first one, from November 23rd, never rendered: its five page pictures expired a day after they were taken, before home knew to fetch them. A fresh Public Pages Capture of the same five pages (run 45454355461) was checked picture by picture against every line. The essay is now on cheat-sheet version 6, and every scene names the file and lines it rests on. A fresh-context review found two lines the pictures and records don't support. One said every rerun on the Actions list was someone else's merge, when only one of the four pushes was. The other cited nothing for a claim about the repository's rule settings. Both are rewritten, along with smaller number and wording fixes. cards-check says ready, and a local Kokoro render came out at 5:53. The card and its index entry went to the coordinator to push to testing.

options: Keep every chapter and card, rewrite only lines the evidence doesn't hold
